tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Projects in the catalogue, filtered by area, developer, bedrooms, maximum starting price in OMR, status or free text. Returns each project with its area, developer, status, starting price in OMR, bedrooms, handover and page URL. Sold-out projects are left out unless include_sold_out is true.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Every published fact of one project: developer, area, status, handover, starting price and price per square metre in OMR, sizes, bedrooms, units, ownership, residency, payment plans, amenities, key distances, the opening answer and the FAQ.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: The areas with a page on the site, with how many catalogue projects each has and whether foreigners may own there.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.description: The developers with a page on the site, with how many catalogue projects each has.
